problem.eyebrow: The event chaos vs the plan
problem.title: From 12 WhatsApp groups and 5 spreadsheets to one shared plan.
problem.body: When updates are scattered across group chats and old attachments, details get missed. Plan My Event keeps everyone working from the same plan.
problem.bubble1: “Wait, did someone send the advance to the caterer or is it pending?”
problem.bubble2: “Check v3 of the Excel sheet… wait, v4 in Drive has the new venue.”
problem.bubble3: “Who has the latest guest list? Mausi added 30 names on Sunday.”

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.body: Three calm steps from a blank slate to showtime.

step1.label: Step 1
step1.title: Pick a template
step1.body: Start from a wedding, conference, fair, celebration or custom template, with sub-events, starter tasks and budget categories ready to go.

step2.label: Step 2
step2.title: Invite your team
step2.body: Add co-hosts, family and volunteers by link or email. Each gets a role that fits, from full admin to helpers who see only their own tasks.

step3.label: Step 3
step3.title: Track everything live
step3.body: Tasks, payments and RSVPs update for everyone within seconds, so nobody has to call around for the latest.

features.title: Features that keep you calm
features.body: Every moving part of your event, in one shared plan.

team.title: Team and roles
team.body: Owners, admins, editors, helpers and viewers, or your own custom roles, limited to the sub-events each person handles.

schedule.title: Schedule and sub-events
schedule.body: Mehendi, keynotes or Day 2: each sub-event has its own time, venue, capacity and guest list.

tasks.title: Tasks that get done
tasks.body: Assign tasks with due dates, priorities and checklists. Helpers get a simple “My tasks” view on their phone.

budget.title: Budget and payments
budget.body: Plan each category, track advances and pending payments in rupees, and see budget against actual at a glance.

guests.title: Guests and RSVPs
guests.body: Households, personal invitation links and one-tap RSVPs. Guests never need an account.

history.title: Live updates and history
history.body: Changes appear for everyone within seconds, and the activity log shows who changed what, with undo for recent edits.

useCases.title: Made for your kind of event

weddings.subtitle: Mehendi, sangeet, wedding, reception

collegeFests.title: College fests
collegeFests.subtitle: Competitions, volunteers, sponsors' deadlines
collegeFests.body: Eighteen competitions, sixty volunteers and one convenor. Give every coordinator their own corner of the plan without losing the big picture.
collegeFests.point1: Each competition as its own sub-event
collegeFests.activity: Arjun added 12 volunteers to Robo Race

fairs.title: Fairs and exhibitions
fairs.subtitle: Days, halls, stalls

guests.title: Guests don't need an app.
guests.body: Send each household its own link by WhatsApp, email or a printed card. Guests reply in one tap and see the time and venue. No account, no download.
guests.point1: A personal link for every household
guests.cardFooter: Works in WhatsApp, Safari and Chrome

ai.title: “Just say what happened.”
ai.body: Type or speak a quick update in English, Hindi or Hinglish. The assistant turns it into task, expense and due-date changes, and nothing is saved until you confirm.
ai.example: “Finalised the caterer, paid 20k advance on UPI, balance due Friday”

free.q: Is Plan My Event really free?
free.a: Yes. The planning core (events, tasks, budget, guests and your team) is free, with limits on the number of events and members. Paid plans raise those limits and include features that cost us per use, like the AI assistant.

guests.q: Do guests need to download an app or create an account?
guests.a: No. Every invitation has its own link that opens in any phone browser. Guests RSVP in one tap, without signing up.

together.q: Can several organisers edit at the same time?
together.a: Yes. Changes appear for everyone within a couple of seconds. If two people edit the same item at once, the second person is told, so nobody's work is silently overwritten.

eventTypes.q: Does it suit Indian weddings as well as tech conferences?
eventTypes.a: Yes. Templates for weddings, conferences, fairs, celebrations and custom events set up the right sub-events, starter tasks and budget categories, and everything can be adjusted.

data.q: How safe is our budget and guest data?
data.a: Only members of your event can see it, and each person sees only what their role allows. Connections are encrypted, and every change is recorded in the activity log.

hindi.q: Is Hindi or regional language support planned?
hindi.a: The app launches in English, with Hindi planned next. The AI assistant will understand English, Hindi and Hinglish when it arrives.

cta.title: Your next event deserves one plan.
cta.body: Leave scattered messages and overlapping sheets behind. Set up your first event in a few minutes.
cta.note: Free to start · No credit card needed

footer.tagline: One plan for everyone behind your event, from guest lists to run sheets and budgets.

devUi.title: UI foundation
devUi.intro: Design tokens from docs/DESIGN.md, rendered in the current theme.
devUi.motionIntro: Tokens from docs/MOTION.md section 2. Components that use them appear below as they are built.

demos.reveal: Fades in and rises 12 px (24 px for headings) when 20% is visible, once.
demos.revealGroup: Staggers its children 80 ms apart (40 ms in lists, max 8 rows).
demos.hoverLift: Rises 4 px and gains the raised shadow on hover (CSS, 150 ms).
demos.sampleHeading: Your whole event team, on the same page.
demos.sampleBody: Tasks, budget, guests and schedule in one shared plan.
demos.countUp: Counts to the value when in view (800 ms), then from the old value on updates (400 ms). en-IN format.
demos.progressFill: Fills from 0 in 600 ms; turns green with a 150 ms fade when it reaches 100%.
demos.checkDraw: Box fills, then the tick draws (250 ms). Reduced motion: the tick fades in.
demos.liveHighlight: Indigo glow behind a changed row: 1.5 s for a teammate's change, 800 ms for your own.
demos.logoMark: Tile pops, tick draws, sparkle pops (1.2 s). Plays once per session in the header; this demo replays it.
demos.confetti: 40 marigold particles, about 1 s, plus the event accent. Nothing fires with reduced motion.
demos.ambientFloat: Drifts ±6 px over 6 s with a per-card offset. Pauses on hover or focus, stops off-screen.
demos.typewriter: Types 35 ms per character when half visible; the caret disappears 2 s after it finishes.
demos.typewriterSample: Finalized the caterer, paid 20k advance via UPI, need balance by Friday

ui.loadingHint: "Send invitations" simulates a 1.5 s save: the spinner replaces the icon only after 300 ms.

faqFree.question: Is Plan My Event free to use?
faqFree.answer: Yes. The free plan covers most family events; paid plans are planned for larger teams.

faqGuests.question: Do guests need an app or an account?
faqGuests.answer: No. Guests open a link, see their invitation and reply in one tap.
